Topic Diversity. Measures how well the extracted topics span distinct semantic areas, computed as the proportion of unique tokens among the top-k keywords across topics. Higher scores indicate broader coverage and less redundancy. Topic Coherence. Assesses the semantic consistency of keywords within each topic using C v . Higher values suggest stronger internal cohesion and better interpretability.
